paper.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
paper.central_claim: 提出统一开源框架 ClawGUI（ClawGUI-RL 在线 RL 基础设施[模拟器+真机]、ClawGUI-Eval 标准化评测流水线、ClawGUI-Agent 真机部署）；在该流水线内端到端训练的 ClawGUI-2B 在 MobileWorld GUI-Only 上 SR 17.1%（同规模 MAI-UI-2B 11.1%）；ClawGUI-Eval 对已发表基线复现率 95.8%。（子主张按各自类型评价：RL 部分≈component_training，Eval 部分≈evaluation_resource。）

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores, then checked against the frozen MAI-UI reference (2512.22047). ClawGUI bundles (i) an online-RL harness on MobileWorld Docker emulators (reset, root-level + MLLM-judge outcome reward, spare-server rotation) with a Qwen3.5-72B PRM step reward and GiGPO, (ii) a three-stage grounding-evaluation harness (46/48 official cells within a one-sided 2-point rule), and (iii) a deployment agent (hybrid CLI/GUI, memory) with no evaluation. ClawGUI-2B (from MAI-UI-2B) reaches 17.1% on 117 MobileWorld GUI-only tasks vs 11.1%; GRPO-binary 14.5 vs GiGPO-dense 17.1 changes estimator and reward together; single runs; training-task source and overlap with the 117 test tasks are not reported; real-device training is called 'validated' with no result. MAI-UI shows the neighbour already has a containerised environment manager with failover and a hybrid rule/MLLM verifier with 83% human agreement, trained only in virtual environments on the same app family as MobileWorld; its own MobileWorld table (116 tasks) lists MAI-UI-8B at 27.5 and no MAI-UI-2B, while ClawGUI's Table 1 copies the other rows verbatim but gives MAI-UI-8B 19.7 and MAI-UI-2B 11.1. Applicable: gui K19, C26, trajectory_level_policy_training; E09, E10, E12, E13, E16, E28.
agreed_items_review: Agreed items X=2, E.measurement=2, E.causality=1, E.cost=1, claim_type system_method, evidence_level online, claim_support scoped were re-checked against the text and MAI-UI; all stand, with E.measurement/E.causality reasons extended by the Table 1 provenance finding.

gap.author_gap: 三缺口：开源在线 RL 基础设施缺失、GUI 基准数字不可比、训练出的 agent 难到达真实用户（E001-E003）。
gap.checked_gap: 缺口1（RL 基础设施闭源）有最近邻佐证：UI-TARS-2 已有统一沙箱/异步 rollout 平台但未释出（E032）；缺口2（评测漂移）的存在性本文并未单独实验量化——仅间接由复现表中 2 处不一致体现（E034/E035）；缺口3（部署）为产品/工程缺口，无度量。

gap.residue: 开源可复现的 GUI 在线 RL 管线仍稀缺；真机在线 RL 的可行性与收益仍无公开证据（本文亦未给出结果）。
gap.stakes: 无法外部复现 → 在线 RL 增益无法独立验证；评测漂移可达“几个点”→ 小幅提升难分辨。
gap.method_response: 提供环境管理器+PRM/GiGPO+评测流水线+部署代理；对 gap1 给出可运行基础设施（但开源完整性无法由全文核验），对 gap2 给出配置钉死与预测公开，对 gap3 给出系统描述。
gap.remaining_gap: 真机训练实效、PRM 的有效性与可靠性、训练/评测任务隔离、与其他开源 RL 栈的并列对比、部署层的任何用户侧评测。
unresolved: “first open-source”“none release infra”仅凭本文引述，无法由固定原文核验（ComputerRL 等未取得全文）。
gap.aggregate_neighbor_check: MAI-UI (2512.22047), the base model and closest neighbour, already runs online RL in a containerised Android environment with a centralised environment manager, failover sessions and a hybrid rule/MLLM verifier validated at 83% human agreement, trained only on virtual devices and with no stated infrastructure release. ClawGUI's residual is therefore open release + physical-device support + step-level credit assignment, not environment management as such; ClawGUI does not acknowledge the overlap, and the physical-device part has no result.

assessment.evidence_level_note: RL claim: MobileWorld interactive benchmark, but training runs in the same MobileWorld environment and the base model was trained on the same app family -> at most online. Eval-harness claim: offline static reproduction. Deployment/real-device: no evidence.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, single run: after GiGPO+PRM training inside MobileWorld emulators, ClawGUI-2B solves 17.1% of 117 GUI-only tasks vs 11.1% for its MAI-UI-2B starting point as evaluated by the authors (about 20 vs 13 tasks), and the GiGPO-dense arm beats a GRPO-binary arm by 3 tasks; the evaluation harness matches 46/48 official grounding cells under a one-sided 2-point rule.

G.reason: Concrete bottlenecks (environment instability, sparse reward, eval drift, no open RL stack) with a now-checkable nearest neighbour: MAI-UI already has the container environment manager, failover and a human-validated hybrid verifier but trains only on virtual devices and releases no infrastructure. The residual (open release, physical devices, step-level credit) is real but narrower than claimed and the overlap is not acknowledged; eval-drift existence is shown only indirectly -> 2.

M.reason: Mechanisms are concrete (unified device interface, spare-server rotation, PRM step score, GiGPO anchor grouping, pinned eval configs), but PRM prompt/scale/combination details are thin, 'dense reward' and the GiGPO estimator are conflated, and real-device reward relies on an unvalidated MLLM judge; no distinguishing prediction against a plain RL-in-MobileWorld baseline.

X.reason: Environment lifecycle, training hyper-parameters and the eval pipeline are described; PRM I/O and reward combination, training task set (source, size, overlap), real-device task set, CLI/GUI routing and memory write/evict rules are missing.

E.measurement.reason: MobileWorld SR uses the benchmark's privileged checks and the grounding judges are explicit, but Table 1 mixes rows copied from MAI-UI's 116-task table with authors' re-runs on 117 tasks (MAI-UI-8B 19.7 vs official 27.5), the reward-side MLLM judge/PRM is unvalidated, and the reproduction rule counts any overshoot as success.

E.causality.reason: Only GRPO-binary vs GiGPO-dense (+3 tasks), which changes estimator and reward together; no PRM on/off, no environment-manager ablation, no same-base continued-training control, yet the gain is attributed 'entirely' to infrastructure and reward design; the 11.1 comparator was evaluated under unstated settings.

E.holdout.reason: After the full text was checked, training-task source, count and disjointness from the 117 test tasks are not reported; training and evaluation share the MobileWorld environment, and the MAI-UI-2B base was itself RL-trained on the same app family. No cross-benchmark, unseen-app or real-device test.
